meta.title: The Return
meta.notes: Import this file first. It contains all NPC definitions and location descriptions referenced by scene files act1_ch1 through act1_ch7.

innkeeper_aldous.name: Aldous
innkeeper_aldous.personality: Cautious. Tired. Knows more than he says. Was kind once.
innkeeper_aldous.secret: He saw the missing person leave with a Rootless woman the night before they disappeared into the forest.
innkeeper_aldous.read: He watches the door more than the room. Whatever he is waiting for, it isn't a customer.

maret.name: Maret
maret.personality: Guarded. Pragmatic. Has seen too much. Protects her people above everything.
maret.secret: She was the last person to see the missing person alive. She made a private arrangement with the curse to protect her people. It cost her something she will not name.
maret.read: She answers before you have finished asking. People who have rehearsed do that.

lira.name: Lira
lira.role: Works rope at the camp's edge
lira.personality: Quiet. Observant. Partly afflicted, and better some days than others.
lira.secret: She has been inside the ruins outskirts and came back changed. She will not say what she saw.
lira.read: Her hands keep working while she talks. When they stop, she has lost the thread.

branch.name: Branch
branch.role: Maret's second. Used to be a soldier
branch.personality: Suspicious. Dry. Loyal to Maret above all. Does not trust outsiders and says so plainly.
branch.secret: He recognises the player from a military record he should not have access to.
branch.read: He stands where he can see the path and the tents at once. He has never come off duty.

lieutenant_cael.name: Lieutenant Cael
lieutenant_cael.role: Compact lieutenant at the east gate
lieutenant_cael.personality: Professional. Polite in a way that does not reach his eyes. Following orders he half-believes in.
lieutenant_cael.secret: Commander Vorne's daughter is showing early curse symptoms. Cael knows. Vorne does not yet.
lieutenant_cael.read: He smiles with the bottom half of his face. The top half is counting what you carry.

priest_edric.name: Edric
priest_edric.role: Covenant priest at the old alderman's hall
priest_edric.personality: Devout. Precise. Believes completely. The certainty never wavers even when the facts argue against it.
priest_edric.secret: The Covenant's oldest texts describe exactly what is happening. He knows the purification ritual will kill as many as the curse does.
priest_edric.read: He never hedges. In your experience, men who never hedge have generally stopped checking.

dockworker_sen.name: Sen
dockworker_sen.role: Works the docks. Knew you before
dockworker_sen.personality: Weathered. Nostalgic. Frightened but will not say of what.
dockworker_sen.secret: He saw something in the river three weeks ago that he has told no one.
dockworker_sen.read: He keeps looking at the water, as if the river owes him an answer.

corvin.name: Corvin
corvin.role: Sells preserved food in the market. Eighty years old
corvin.personality: Eighty years old. Seen everything. Says exactly what he means in as few words as possible.
corvin.secret: He saw the missing person and the Rootless woman together, the night before they went east.
corvin.read: He tells you more than he means to, and he knows exactly how much.

hanna.name: Hanna
hanna.personality: Efficient. Frightened. Doing what she can for people who are worse off. Running low on optimism.
hanna.secret: She has been supplementing the Rootless camp with grain she writes off the books. If the Compact found out she would lose her stall.
hanna.read: She weighs the grain twice. She does not trust her own hands any more.

still_man_wren.name: Wren
still_man_wren.role: Sits by the Tallow's fire. Was the man everyone liked
still_man_wren.personality: Was warm, community-minded, the person everyone liked. Now diminished. Still present, partially.
still_man_wren.secret: He went to the forest edge alone six months ago, touched something, and came back changed. He has told no one.
still_man_wren.read: Somebody is still in there. He turns his cup so the handle faces the fire.

crestfall_docks.name: Crestfall Docks
crestfall_docks.description: Rotting wood and cold water. Three barges are moored, and there is a warehouse with a broken lock. Beyond it you can see the town: smoke from the chimneys, a church spire, and the market bell, which doesn't ring any more.
crestfall_docks.ambient_day: Quiet, with one or two men working. The ferryman comes and goes.
crestfall_docks.ambient_night: Empty, except for one lamp swinging in the wind off the water.

crestfall_tallow_inn.name: The Tallow Inn
crestfall_tallow_inn.description: Low beams, and a fire that burns lower than it should. There are six tables, and seldom more than three of them taken. Aldous is behind the bar. The third stair creaks, as it always did.
crestfall_tallow_inn.ambient_day: Nearly empty. Aldous wipes the bar whether it needs it or not.
crestfall_tallow_inn.ambient_night: Quieter than an inn ought to be. The fire is let die down before closing.

crestfall_market.name: Crestfall Market Square
crestfall_market.description: Half the stalls are empty, and the rest sell less than they used to. People go through without stopping to talk. The fountain in the middle hasn't run for months. Somebody left a bunch of flowers at the foot of it, and nobody has cleared them away.
crestfall_market.ambient_day: Three stalls open in the mornings, and they have gone by the afternoon.
crestfall_market.ambient_night: Empty. Nobody stays about in the square after dark.

crestfall_gate.name: Crestfall East Gate
crestfall_gate.description: A checkpoint that wasn't here eleven years ago, with two Iron Compact soldiers on it at all hours. Beyond the gate you can see the east road, turning to mud where the cobbles stop.
crestfall_gate.ambient_day: Manned. Cael or one of his men watches everyone who goes by.
crestfall_gate.ambient_night: Manned, with a lamp over the gate. Nobody goes by without being noticed.

crestfall_shrine.name: Ashen Covenant Shrine
crestfall_shrine.description: The old alderman's hall, which the Covenant took over three years ago. Inside there are candles, bowls of ash, and a carved figure with no face. The grey flag over the door is new since your day.
crestfall_shrine.ambient_day: Edric or one of the younger priests is always there, and incense is burning.
crestfall_shrine.ambient_night: Open, with a single candle showing in the window.

rootless_camp.name: The Rootless Camp
rootless_camp.description: Just beyond the eastern edge of the town, where the town has stopped looking after the land and the forest hasn't quite taken it. Fifteen tents and a fire in the middle. Along the south side runs a herb garden that grows far too well for this soil.
rootless_camp.ambient_day: Busy, with people about their work. Wary, but not unfriendly.
rootless_camp.ambient_night: Never quite quiet. The fire is kept in, and somebody is always awake.

east_road.name: The East Road
east_road.description: Cobbles for the first mile, then packed earth, and then not so much a road as the way people have happened to go. After the second mile the forest closes in on both sides. There are no birds, and the light under the trees is grey and thin.
east_road.ambient_day: Empty, but for the odd animal track. Nobody is travelling east.
east_road.ambient_night: Not a road to travel at night.

abandoned_village_harrow.name: Harrow
abandoned_village_harrow.description: Twelve houses, a well, a barn the village shared, and a small shrine to a local saint, defaced. Everything is where it was built. There are meals on three tables, tools leaning against walls, and beds left unmade. There are no bodies and no blood. The people were simply here, and then they were not.
abandoned_village_harrow.ambient_day: The wrong silence, the kind a place makes when people used to live in it and don't.
abandoned_village_harrow.ambient_night: Not a place to stay at night without a roof over you. The wrong silence grows louder.

forest_edge.name: The Deep Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: The place where the trees stop being trees you know. The bark is darker, and they stand too regularly, as if they had been planted rather than grown. The ground is soft though there has been no rain. Beyond the line there is no sound at all, and the silence seems to be a thing in itself.
forest_edge.ambient_day: You can see the line, and the difference between one side and the other is plain at once.
forest_edge.ambient_night: Not a place to be at night.

childhood_home_area.name: The Mill Lane
childhood_home_area.description: Down the hill from the baker's, past the crumbling mill wall. The house you grew up in, with someone else's shutters.

dice_rules.modifier_formula: Table: 6 or less −2, 7 to 8 −1, 9 to 10 0, 11 to 12 +1, 13 to 14 +3, 15 to 16 +5, 17+ +6. Bonuses from earlier choices add to it, capped at ±6. The source of truth is src/rules.ts.
